notes.title: My Truck Game Update 0.9 - Grass Touch Bending, New Truck & New Map
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=z755OvcTYoQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Main Changes:


 Implemented grass touch bending, now the grass will bend if the player walks over it or when a vehicle drives over the grass.
 Added a new flatbed truck.
 Added a new map named The Mountains.

Gameplay Changes:


 Increased the amount of money that you can earn for each delivery.
 Added the cargo value to the truck UI in order to be able to see how much you can earn if you deliver the cargo to the destination.

notes.title: Update 0.08 - Transport Missions, Earnings, New Map, New Truck
notes.content:
Main Changes


 Cargo transport missions.
 Earn money from the transport missions.
 Buying vehicles.
 Buying fuel.
 Navigation Map.
 Option to use Clutch.
 New Truck (Torq 6) with 2 versions (Dump Truck and Tanker Truck).
 New Map (The Hills).
 Added more roads on all the maps.


Gameplay Changes


 At the start of the game you will own just 1 truck and you will need to earn money to be able to buy more vehicles.
 On the Suspension Test Map you will be able to use any vehicle you want even if you don't own it.
 If the vehicle has less than 5 Galons of fuel it will get refueld for free in the garage up to 5 Galons of fuel.
 If you reset a loaded vehicle you will lose the load.

notes.title: My Truck Game & Offroad Mania - BUNDLE
notes.content:
ABOUT THIS BUNDLE

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27811/Automobile_Sim_Bundle/

Automobile Sim Bundle includes:

Offroad Mania — based on realistic car physics for anyone who likes casual off road driving and tough challenges. Play different modes: Classic (240 levels), Free roam, Racing, Endless. Unlock 10+ amazing 4×4 off road cars for much driving fun. We update the game with free content regularly!

My Truck Game — this game is focused on physics based off road truck and bus simulation. The main priority is tire deformation and suspension simulation for heavy vehicles.

My Truck Game Next Update

At the moment work is being done on a game update which will bring transport missions to the game and an economy system.
You will be able to transport cargos to diferrent destinations and earn money which will be necessary in order to buy trucks and fuel.

notes.title: City Bus Released + H-Shifter Implementation
notes.content:
City bus added to the game.
 H-Shifter implementation (only tested with Logitech Driving Force Shifter for G29), in order to shift into gears higher than 6th gear, press the Range Button (D-Pad Left on the Steering Wheel or Right Shift on the Keyboard).
 Fixed some textures on the 8x8 tanker truck.
 There have been a lot of changes to the code for the gearbox and fixed some mistakes on the code for the engine RPM and torque.

notes.title: Update 0.03 - X 11 Heavy Tractor
notes.content:
The X 11 Heavy Tractor plus dump trailer released

- Tractor weight 17.5 tons
- Engine 530 hp
- 50 km/h (31 mph) top speed
- 4-wheel drive
- 4-wheel steering
- Cabin suspension
- Dump trailer with a maximum authorized load of 20 tons (it can be loaded with more than that)
